description: Search the catalogue of space products (satellites, platforms, structures, launchers, engines, spacesuits, rovers, observatories, stations) by what they are, who makes them, what they are made of and how. Call it first when you design or study a device: "comparable 3U CubeSat structures" = kind structure + size 3U; "who flies aluminium 6061" = material aluminium-6061; "which products use anodised parts per MIL-A-8625" = finish + standard; "launchers by SpaceX" = category launchers + maker. All filters are optional and combine (AND). text matches every word against names, aliases (F9, Orlan, EMU), summaries, specs, features, parts, materials and organizations. Returns, per product, its id (use it with get_product), maker, kind, category, size / mass / orbit tags, a depth label (full, partial or materials-only: how complete its parts list is), counts of parts, materials, specs and unverified quotes, and the page. It does not return the parts: call get_product or product_parts for those. An empty result means no product in this catalogue matches, not that none exists.

bom_depth.description: Only products whose parts list has this depth

category.description: Catalogue group: platforms, structures, launchers, engines, suits, rovers, crew, stations, observatories, solar, thermal, reports, missions

finish.description: Finish to match, for example anodize, chromate, black paint

form.description: Part form to match, for example honeycomb, plate, sheet, tube

kind.description: platform, structure, satellite, mission (launchers, vehicles, rovers, suits, observatories) or component

maker.description: Maker name or part of it, for example nasa or "Blue Origin"

mass.description: Mass tag to match, for example "Under 1 kg"

material.description: A material id, for example aluminium-6061 or pi-kapton-hn: products that use it

orbit.description: Orbit tag to match, for example "low earth", geostationary, "sun-synchronous"

org.description: Any organization with a stated role on the product (maker, contractor, supplier, operator), by name or id

part_function.description: Part function: structure, thermal control, power, propulsion, mechanisms, avionics, optics, protection or other. DERIVED by explicit name rules from the part names (marked function_basis "derived"), not stated by the sources.

size.description: Size tag to match, for example 1U, 3U, "6U and larger", Microsatellite

standard.description: Standard to match, for example MIL-A-8625 or AMS

text.description: Words to find, for example "heat shield ablator" or "F9" (aliases work)

name: find_products
title: Find space products
